landing.heroDescription: Design your site structure on a diagram, add content blocks and SEO fields. Multiple projects, browser storage, JSON and Markdown export — no account required.
landing.heroFootnote: No account. Shortcuts: ⌘K search, ⌘D duplicate page,
landing.previewFootnote: Each card: sections, meta, and page intent
landing.previewStickerBody: One file for copy and engineering.
landing.problemTitle: Site structure should not live in a spreadsheet
landing.problemBody: When IA and SEO drift across Slack threads and columns, it is hard to agree what actually ships. Canopy brings page tree, content blocks, and SEO fields into one view — so everyone sees the same picture.
landing.problemPoint1: One map instead of scattered threads and attachments
landing.problemPoint2: Sections on each page — fewer “what goes here?” moments
landing.problemPoint3: Meta and intent next to the node, not in another tab
landing.howSubtitle: Three short steps from messy notes to a clear brief.
landing.howStep1Body: Add pages, connect them, and auto-layout. You see hierarchy as a diagram, not a flat list.
landing.howStep2Body: Select a page — in the panel you add sections plus title, meta, slug, H1, and intent.
landing.howStep3Body: Download JSON to move between devices or Markdown for briefs and Notion.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything before build in one workspace
landing.featuresSubtitle: One app instead of a whiteboard, a sheet, and ten Slack threads.
landing.feature1Body: Nodes and edges in React Flow: drag, connect, auto-layout (Dagre). Site structure is visible at a glance.
landing.feature2Body: Each page has a block plan with a preview on the diagram — headings, notes, order without guesswork.
landing.feature3Body: Title, meta description, slug, H1, keyword, and page intent — a dedicated tab for the selected page.
landing.feature4Body: Multiple maps in one browser. Dexie (IndexedDB) plus JSON or Markdown export for handoff.
landing.faqSubtitle: Privacy, SEO, and teamwork — in short.
landing.faq1A: Canopy is a tool for visually planning website structure: a page tree, content sections, and SEO fields. Built for UX folks, copywriters, and SEO leads.
landing.faq2A: Maps are stored locally in your browser (IndexedDB). We do not send your content to a server unless you export JSON or Markdown yourself.
landing.faq3Q: How do I move a project to another computer?
landing.faq3A: Export JSON from the editor and import it on the other device. You can also generate Markdown with hierarchy and sections.
landing.faq4A: No — Canopy is for planning and alignment before launch. Crawlers analyze the live site; here you design the target information architecture.
landing.ctaBandTitle: Ready for one map everyone agrees on?
landing.ctaBandBody: Open the editor, add your first page, and sketch sections today.
